escalation: NEITHER horizon makes tau_sat=96 reachable on the trained fixed machine -- per the ruling this receipt IS the escalation artifact; the arms do not run until the supervisor rules (the calibrated-threshold branch of §5, or the informative null)

predictions.P_G1: the fixed GDN2 arm's state saturates in-regime: the smoothed mean per-head participation ratio reaches tau_sat=96 on the trained fixed machine (receipted by the calibration scan itself)
predictions.P_G2: gdn2_growth beats gdn2_fixed by MORE than 0.075 nats/byte on the post-cooldown PRIMARY score AND the tau_sat trigger fired in-regime; a tie within the band, or a never-fired trigger, is the declared informative null (the K8 tie branch), reported as such
predictions.P_G3: emender_growable beats gdn2_growth by MORE than 0.075 nats/byte post-cooldown at matched exposure (state sizes and parameter deltas first-class); gdn2_growth >= emender_growable within the band refutes the slot story's necessity at this scale
predictions.fixed_8: the born-at-8 size control: separates grown-large from born-large; no directional prediction pre-stated (the registration states none for the control)
